name: Слабкості в дебюті (1)
description: Every game begins with an open battle for control of the board, and vulnerabilities can quickly arise. During the opening, small mistakes can rapidly lead to big problems because pieces are not yet well-developed and the king may still be in the center of the board. A careless pawn move or an early king move can weaken your defense, giving your opponent opportunities to attack quickly.

examples.text: The white f-pawn has just been pushed forward, setting off all the alarms! The black queen leaps forward to capitalize on this. After a combination, Black wins decisive material.
